description:
Reproduced 2026-09-14 at main f26264572: `add = fn a, b -> a + b end` fails to parse with "expected `->`, got Comma". Single-parameter fn and multi-clause fn parse. Elixir accepts any arity, with commas between parameters and `when` guards after them: `fn a, b when a > b -> a; _, _ -> 0 end`.

Fix: the fn-clause head parser reads a comma-separated parameter list up to `when` or `->`, the same list the def head parser reads. Signal: a fixture with two- and three-parameter lambdas, a guarded multi-parameter clause, and a pinned parameter beside a plain one (`fn ^x, y -> y end`), with an oracle twin.
title: A multi-parameter anonymous function does not parse
